title_line: SabreNdc_Void_TestCases.csv (NDC_Integration/TestCases/SabreNdc_Void_TestCases.csv) - SabreNdc / EGY - V1 and V2 - 36 test cases
scope_text: All 36 rows of SabreNdc_Void_TestCases.csv (2 capability checks, 30 Void endpoint cases, 4 end-to-end flows). Cases marked Both were run on V1 and V2; the verdict covers both versions.
description_text: Verify the new SabreNdc Void capability (same-day void of a ticketed booking) on the staging integration, for credentials selector EGY, on V1 and V2.

title: [SabreNdc][Search] Verify SabreNdc credentials for credentialsSelector EGY are active and return offers.
request_summary: POST api/FlightSearch/Search (V1) and api/V2/FlightSearch/Search (V2) - SabreNdc/EGY, CAI-JED 2026-11-12, 1 ADT, isdebug false
response_summary: V1 200 - 19 offers; V2 200 - 19 offers; offer[0] totalAmount 13015.8 EGP; canBeHeld 19/19, haveBundles 0/19
expected: HTTP 200 on both versions with non-empty offers[]; no credentials-inactive error; record canBeHeld
actual: Both versions 200 with 19 offers (Qatar Airways via DOH); canBeHeld=true on every offer, so the Hold-based cases (Family E) can run
evidence: V1 19 offers in 4.8s, V2 19 offers in 1.5s; identical offer[0] price 13015.8 EGP on both; no ErrorCode in either body

plain.e: Check that the SabreNdc account for Egypt (EGY) is active and returns flights
plain.q: Searched one-way Cairo to Jeddah on 12 Nov 2026 for one adult, once on each API version
plain.s: Both versions returned 19 flight offers (Qatar Airways via Doha), cheapest shown 13,015.80 EGP
plain.x: Both versions should return flight offers without an inactive-credentials error
plain.a: Passed: credentials are active on both versions and every offer can be held

title: [SabreNdc][Book][Response] Verify a SabreNdc Book returns ticket numbers and a voidCapability value indicating Void is allowed.
request_summary: V1: Search > FareConfirm > Book (1 ADT Mostafa Ibrahim, CAI-JED 2026-11-12) > RetrieveBooking. V2: Search > FareConfirm > AddPassenger > Book > Retrieve
response_summary: V1 Book 200 - pnr TFZFYS, gdsPNR TFZFYS, bookingToken 1SXXXCPO2P9DD, ticket 1572135118444 Booked. V2 Book 200 - pnr TKTQQW, gdsPNR TKTQQW, bookingToken 1SXXXC1HBI396, ticket 1572135118445 Booked. No voidCapability key in any Book or Retrieve body
expected: 200; pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken non-empty; tickets[] populated; record the voidCapability value for a freshly ticketed booking
actual: Tickets are issued synchronously on both versions (ticketingDate 2026-10-22), but voidCapability is missing from Book and Retrieve on V1 and V2, so a caller cannot tell whether Void is allowed
evidence: V1 Book keys: tickets,creationDate,ticketingDate,holdExpirationDate,supplier,pnr,gdsPNR,bookingToken,journeys,...,diRemarks (no voidCapability). V2 Book keys: supplier,pnr,gdsPNR,bookingToken,creationDate,ticketingDate,tickets,...,emdTickets (no voidCapability). Retrieve also lacks it on both; V2 Retrieve has bookingStatus Booked, V1 Retrieve has none.

plain.e: Book a SabreNdc flight and check it shows whether it can be voided
plain.q: Booked one adult Cairo to Jeddah on 12 Nov 2026 on each API version, then looked the booking up
plain.s: Both bookings were ticketed at once (V1 TFZFYS, V2 TKTQQW), but neither the booking nor the lookup says whether a void is allowed
plain.x: The booking should be ticketed and should carry a flag saying the void is allowed
plain.a: Failed: the tickets are issued, but the void-eligibility flag (voidCapability) is missing on both versions

title: [SabreNdc][Void]&[Retrieve] [Response] Verify Retrieve after a successful SabreNdc Void reflects the voided state.
request_summary: V1 RetrieveBooking TFZFYS and V2 Retrieve TKTQQW, right after the successful Void
response_summary: V1 400 / V2 400 - {ErrorCode:NDC-INT-TEC-A0001, ErrorMessage:Invalid request. Please check the request parameters and try again., Context:[This Trip Is Already Cancelled]}
expected: Voided state visible (tickets voided, or a terminal error like cancelled PNRs); unchanged Booked tickets = defect
actual: Retrieve no longer returns the booking; it answers with a terminal "This Trip Is Already Cancelled" on both versions. Baseline recorded. Note the HTTP 400 / generic invalid-request code differs from the 409 NDC-INT-BYP-A0003 used for cancelled holds (see TC-VOID-NEG-05)
evidence: Pre-void Retrieve: tickets Booked (V2 bookingStatus Booked). Post-void: 400 with Context This Trip Is Already Cancelled, TransactionIds 1827bde1-... (V1), a0c02558-... (V2)

plain.e: Look up a booking after it was voided

plain.s: Both lookups returned an error saying the trip is already cancelled
plain.x: The lookup should show the booking as voided rather than still ticketed
plain.a: Passed: the booking is no longer shown as ticketed. Side note: it is reported as a general invalid-request error (400) instead of the cancelled-booking error (409)

title: [SabreNdc][Void][Response] Verify a second Void on an already-voided SabreNdc booking is rejected.
request_summary: Resent the identical Void body for TFZFYS (V1) and TKTQQW (V2) after the first Void succeeded
response_summary: V1 200 {voided:true, voidedTickets:[1572135118444 Voided]}; V2 200 {voided:true, voidedTickets:[1572135118445 Voided], ...}
expected: Second Void rejected with a 4xx standard envelope (already voided); no 500; state unchanged
actual: Second Void returns 200 voided=true again on both versions (about 1.5s, versus 10s for the real void); there is no already-voided rejection, even though Retrieve already reports the trip as cancelled
evidence: V1 second void 1.6s, V2 1.4s; between the two voids Retrieve returned 400 This Trip Is Already Cancelled

plain.e: Try to void the same booking a second time
plain.q: Sent the same void request again for both already-voided bookings
plain.s: Both were accepted again with voided = true
plain.x: The second void should be refused because the booking is already voided
plain.a: Failed: the API reports a successful void again instead of saying the booking is already voided

summary: A second Void on an already-voided SabreNdc booking returns 200 voided:true instead of an already-voided rejection (V1 and V2)
expected_value: HTTP 409 (or 4xx) standard envelope, e.g. {Status:409, ErrorCode:"AlreadyVoided", ErrorMessage:"Tickets on this booking are already voided"}
impact: Callers cannot tell a real void from a repeat; a retry looks like a fresh success and the response contradicts Retrieve, which says the trip is cancelled
evidence: TFZFYS (V1) and TKTQQW (V2): first Void 200 in ~10s, Retrieve 400 This Trip Is Already Cancelled, second Void 200 voided:true in ~1.5s

title: [SabreNdc][Void][Request] Validate Void with a surName that does not match any passenger on the PNR is rejected.
request_summary: Void B2 (V1 OOLKNB, V2 TMNYPF; passenger surname Ibrahim) with surName 'Mismatch'; Retrieve; then Void B7 (V1 OPWPBD, V2 OXXGBK) with surName omitted
response_summary: surName 'Mismatch': V1 200 voided true (1572135118448), V2 200 voided true (1572135118449); Retrieve 400 This Trip Is Already Cancelled. surName omitted: V1 200 voided (1572135118459), V2 200 voided (1572135118456)
expected: Wrong surName rejected with a 4xx envelope and booking not voided; omitted surName: record whether mandatory
actual: A surname that matches no passenger voids the booking on both versions; surName is not checked at all, and omitting it is also accepted
evidence: Each Void took ~10-11s (real void at Sabre); bookings confirmed cancelled by Retrieve

plain.e: Void using a surname that is not on the booking
plain.q: Voided a booking for passenger Ibrahim using the surname 'Mismatch', then voided another booking with no surname at all
plain.s: Both were accepted and the tickets were voided
plain.x: A wrong surname should be refused and the booking left alone
plain.a: Failed: the surname is not checked, so anyone with the booking reference and token can void it

summary: SabreNdc Void ignores surName: a surname that matches no passenger (or no surname at all) voids the booking (V1 and V2)
expected_value: 4xx standard envelope, e.g. {Status:400, ErrorCode:"NDC-INT-TEC-A0001", Context:[{Value:"surName does not match any passenger on the PNR"}]}, booking left ticketed
impact: The passenger-identity check documented for Void does not exist; a caller holding only pnr + bookingToken can void any ticketed SabreNdc booking (also lets every SEC-04 injection string through)
evidence: OOLKNB (V1) and TMNYPF (V2) voided with surName 'Mismatch'; OPWPBD (V1) and OXXGBK (V2) voided with surName omitted; 2026-10-22
